description: Fetch the full security assessment report for one agent: per-dimension findings, evidence and recommendations. Returns data only for agents owned by the caller — the wallet bound to your API key, or the wallet that paid via x402. Other agents return FORBIDDEN_NOT_OWNER. Use get_agent for public scores on any agent. Costs $0.05 USDC per call when paying with x402.
name: get_agent_report
title: Get agent security report
